hooks.command: bash -c 'path=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path" <<< "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"); if echo "$path" | grep -qE "^(dist|build|\\.next|node_modules|coverage|target|vendor)/"; then echo "Blocked: attempting to edit generated directory"; exit 1; fi'

bash -c 'case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.rs) (cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -50) ;; esac'

bash -c 'case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) (cd "$(dirname $(find . -maxdepth 4 -name package.json -path "*/ui/*" | head -1) 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null && npx --no-install prettier --write "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null) || true ;; esac'

bash -c 'case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) (cd "$(dirname $(find . -maxdepth 4 -name package.json -path "*/ui/*" | head -1) 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null && npx --no-install eslint --fix "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null) || true ;; esac'

bash -c 'case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.ts|*.tsx) (cd "$(dirname $(find . -maxdepth 4 -name tsconfig.json -path "*/ui/*" | head -1) 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null && npx --no-install tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -30) || true ;; esac'
